criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Alarm
categories.definition: Requests to set an alarm for a specific time or recurring schedule.

categories.name: Set Timer
categories.definition: Requests to set, adjust, or inquire about a countdown timer.

categories.name: Send Message
categories.definition: Requests to send a text or video message to a contact.

categories.name: Make Call
categories.definition: Requests to initiate a phone or video call with a contact.

categories.name: Manage Reminders
categories.definition: Requests to create, update, or delete reminders.

categories.name: Weather Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for current or forecasted weather information.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: Requests to play, change, or repeat music tracks or playlists.

categories.name: News Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for the latest news or specific news topics.

categories.name: Recipe Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for recipes or cooking instructions.

categories.name: Contact Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for information about contacts or their availability.

categories.name: Event Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for information about events or activities.

categories.name: Timer Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests to check the remaining time on a timer.

categories.name: Status Update
categories.definition: Requests to change or update the user's status or visibility.

categories.name: General Inquiry
categories.definition: Requests for general information not covered by other categories.
